title: Affine presentations and symmetric-algebra surjection for the sheaf Rees algebra
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent ideal [pqf-def-coherent]. Put $\mathcal R=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}\mathcal I^n$, the quasi-coherent sheaf Rees algebra [def-nagata-sheaf-rees-algebra], with ideal powers [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers], and let $\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal I)$ have its symmetric grading [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-symmetric-algebra] [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra]. Then there are graded $\mathcal O_X$-algebra identifications and a morphism with the following properties.

For every affine open $V=\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq X$, put $I_V=\Gamma(V,\mathcal I)$. There is a canonical graded $R$-algebra isomorphism
$$\theta_V:\Gamma(V,\mathcal R)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal R_R(I_V)\subseteq R[t],$$
where the right side is the Rees algebra [def-nagata-rees-algebra]. In degree $n$, it sends $x\in\Gamma(V,\mathcal I^n)=I_V^n$ to $xt^n$, and in degree zero it is the identity of $R$. Under these identifications all affine restriction maps act coefficientwise; in particular on $D(s)\subseteq V$ the degree-$n$ map is $xt^n\mapsto(x/1)t^n$.

The degree-one inclusion $\mathcal I\to\mathcal R$ extends uniquely to a morphism $\varphi:\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal I)\to\mathcal R$ of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-algebras. This morphism preserves degree and is surjective in every degree on every affine open. Under the canonical identification $\Gamma(V,\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal I))=\operatorname{Sym}_R(I_V)$ and $\theta_V$, its degree-$n$ map sends the symmetric monomial $x_1\cdots x_n$ to $(x_1\cdots x_n)t^n$; its degree-zero map is the identity. These formulas commute with affine restriction. No finite-type, Noetherian or nonzero-ideal hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tag 02NS (lemma-blowing-up-projective), proof: symmetric-to-Rees surjection; affine computation of the sheaf Rees algebra.

proof.text: Fix an affine open $V=\operatorname{Spec}R$ and set $I=\mathcal I(V)$. By [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers], $\mathcal I^n|_V=\widetilde{I^n}$. Restriction to $V$ preserves coproducts by [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]. Thus the defining coproduct of [def-nagata-sheaf-rees-algebra] restricts to the coproduct of the $\widetilde{I^n}$. Apply clause (4) of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction] to the module direct sum $M=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}I^n$: its associated sheaf is this coproduct, with the specified summand inclusions. Clause (2) then gives $\Gamma(V,\mathcal R)=M$, compatibly with those inclusions. In particular these sections have finite degree support. This uses preservation of coproducts by the associated-sheaf functor, rather than an assertion that arbitrary global-sections functors preserve coproducts.

Send the finite tuple $(a_n)_n$ of Step 1 to $\sum_n a_nt^n$. By [def-nagata-rees-algebra], coefficient extraction is its inverse onto $\mathcal R_R(I)$. The degree-$n$ summand is sent to $I^nt^n$. Addition is coefficientwise; the multiplication in [def-nagata-sheaf-rees-algebra] sends $a_m,b_n$ to $a_mb_n$ in degree $m+n$, just as polynomial multiplication does. The unit is the degree-zero $1$. This proves that the resulting $\theta_V$ is a graded $R$-algebra isomorphism and is the identity in degree zero.

source.place: Tag 0804 (lemma-blowing-up-affine), affine Rees algebra in the statement and proof; Schemes Tag 01ID.

proof.text: Let $W\subseteq V$ be affine, and write $r:R\to\mathcal O_X(W)$ for restriction. Each coproduct insertion is a sheaf map, so restriction carries $\sum_n\iota_n(a_n)$ to $\sum_n\iota_n(a_n|_W)$. The inclusions $\mathcal I^n\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ identify $a_n|_W$ with $r(a_n)$; hence under the two maps $\theta$ restriction is $\sum_n a_nt^n\mapsto\sum_n r(a_n)t^n$. For $W=D(s)$, apply [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections] to the module $I^n$ and the presentation in [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]: its localization formula gives $a_n\mapsto a_n/1$. This proves the asserted restriction formulas without assuming intersections of arbitrary affine opens are affine.

source.place: Tag 01HV (lemma-spec-sheaves), localization of associated-module sections, and Tag 01I9 (lemma-widetilde-pullback).

proof.text: The coproduct inclusion $\iota_1:\mathcal I\to\mathcal R$ is $\mathcal O_X$-linear and $\mathcal R$ is a commutative $\mathcal O_X$-algebra by [def-nagata-sheaf-rees-algebra]. Apply clause (a) of [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-symmetric-algebra] to $\mathcal F=\mathcal I$, $\mathcal B=\mathcal R$, $u=\iota_1$. It supplies a unique algebra-sheaf morphism $\varphi$ extending this inclusion. Clause (b) identifies its affine source with $\operatorname{Sym}_R(I)$. Since it is an algebra morphism, it fixes $R$, and on a product of $n$ degree-one generators its affine component, followed by $\theta_V$, is exactly $x_1\cdots x_n\mapsto(x_1\cdots x_n)t^n$.

source.place: Tags 01CF (section-symmetric-exterior), 01CG (lemma-local-tensor-algebra), 01CL (lemma-whole-tensor-algebra-permanence); Divisors Tag 02NS (lemma-blowing-up-projective), displayed symmetric-to-Rees map.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-graded], the degree-$n$ part of $\operatorname{Sym}_R(I)$ is spanned over $R$ by the monomials $x_1\cdots x_n$. The grading and affine identifications are those of [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra]. Step 4 sends each such generator into $I^nt^n$, so $\varphi$ preserves degree on every affine open, and hence as a sheaf morphism. It is onto in degree $n$: by the definition of ideal multiplication every element of $I^n$ is a finite sum $\sum_j c_jx_{j1}\cdots x_{jn}$ with $c_j\in R$ and $x_{ji}\in I$. Explicitly this holds for $n=0$ since $I^0=R$; the inductive step expands an element of $I^{n+1}=I^nI$ as a finite sum of products and inserts the degree-$n$ expressions. Its preimage is $\sum_j c_j\iota(x_{j1})\cdots\iota(x_{jn})$ in symmetric degree $n$. At $n=0$ use the scalar itself. No finite generation of $I$ is used.

source.place: Tag 00DM (section-tensor-algebra), symmetric powers generated by monomials; Divisors Tag 02NS (lemma-blowing-up-projective), the displayed surjection.

proof.text: For an affine inclusion $W\subseteq V$ with restriction $r$, the restriction in [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra] sends $c\,\iota(x_1)\cdots\iota(x_n)$ to $r(c)\,\iota(r(x_1))\cdots\iota(r(x_n))$. Both orders of applying restriction and Step 4 therefore give $r(c)r(x_1)\cdots r(x_n)t^n$, by multiplicativity of $r$ and Step 3. These monomials span every degree, so the formulas commute for every section. The same formula covers degree zero. The unique morphism of Step 4 thus has all the requested affine, graded and surjectivity properties. For $I=0$, all positive target degrees vanish; for $I=R$ the target is $R[t]$; the empty affine has zero section rings. The argument applies unchanged to these cases.
